title: A contractor approved another team's access request (Cedar)
scenario: A contractor manager approved a payments request through the agent's gateway tool even though the Cedar policy set forbids cross-team approvals. The engine had just moved from LOG_ONLY to ENFORCE, and on-call wants to roll back. Find the real cause in the decision log, fix the policy and prove it with schema validation.
task: Read determining policies and evaluation errors in the decision log
Explain how Cedar treats a policy that errors
Fix the forbid with the smallest change; keep every guard rail
Pass schema validation and say why it would have caught this
acceptance: Correct decisions for workforce and partner principals
Schema validation passes; no evaluation errors
ANSWER.md explains error-skip with log evidence
